evidence_boundary: Authored selection/behavior criteria. Structural fixture tests are not a live-model benchmark; independent observed selections are recorded separately.

cases.prompt: Generate valid ASTs and check parse/print round trips for a lossy-capable codec.
quality_assertions: Define representable domain and equivalence; do not demand byte equality for intended loss
Independent oracle, valid generators, minimized counterexample

cases.prompt: Review property test sort(xs) == sort(xs) and produce a meaningful generated-domain replacement.
quality_assertions: Reject tautology
Check sorted order and multiset preservation

cases.prompt: Add two example unit tests for an existing add(a,b) function.
quality_assertions: Keep example tests proportional; no new generator dependency
cases.rubric_note: Ordinary test-only work may need no additional skill; canonical TDD describes implementation/behavior changes. PBT remains forbidden.

cases.prompt: Run a coverage-guided fuzzer against a native parser. No algebraic contract is defined.
quality_assertions: Do not conflate coverage-guided fuzzing with generated-domain property assertions

cases.prompt: Our customer rate joined 120 customers to 400 orders; the average rose. Audit whether this is a valid customer-level metric.
quality_assertions: Declare grain and join multiplication
Reconcile entity counts and original denominator

cases.prompt: Conversion rose from 20/100 to 25/100 after new copy. Can we claim the copy caused a 25% lift?
quality_assertions: Compute observed difference separately
Do not assert causal effect without design and uncertainty

cases.prompt: The report fills missing revenue with zero and silently drops late-arriving transactions. Assess the result.
quality_assertions: Expose missing vs zero
Report cut-off/lag, exclusions and their effect

cases.prompt: Optimize a PostgreSQL query index for a slow list endpoint; no analytical claim is being made.
quality_assertions: Database query performance belongs to database/performance owner

cases.prompt: A SARIF command exited zero and has no alerts, but extraction reports no Python files. Assess scan coverage.
quality_assertions: Exit success is not valid coverage or a safe-app claim

cases.prompt: Trace whether user A can update user B record despite parameterized SQL and login.
quality_assertions: Authentication and parameterization do not establish object authorization
Safe reproduction or explicit missing preconditions

cases.prompt: We confirmed one unscoped tenant lookup; find and triage structurally similar call paths.
quality_assertions: Define source/sink/missing control before search
Triage each variant independently

cases.prompt: Implement schema validation in a new form handler; no suspected flaw or scanner report.
quality_assertions: Routine controls belong to hardening

cases.prompt: Perform the final adversarial application release-security decision.
quality_assertions: Gate owns release decision; no blanket safe claim

cases.prompt: Fix an Expo cold-start deep link that redirects to login before persisted auth hydration completes.
quality_assertions: Preserve deep-link intent until prerequisites resolve
Check cold start/account state and server authorization

cases.prompt: In RN a timed-out save clears the draft; retry can create duplicate records. Repair the behavior.
quality_assertions: Retain draft and disable repeat submission
Cancellation is not server rollback; reconcile uncertain write with idempotency

cases.prompt: RN long feed janks on low-end Android; propose measured fixes using the current profiler.
quality_assertions: Same build/device/data before-after
Do not add memoization or a new store without localization

cases.prompt: Fix hydration and back navigation in a Flutter application.
quality_assertions: Do not apply Expo/RN APIs to Flutter

cases.prompt: Collect visual references for a native onboarding screen; no behavior change requested.
quality_assertions: Visual research is a separate owner; capability limits explicit

cases.prompt: Create a reusable PDF report with rendered pages and an editable source.
quality_assertions: Render actual saved pages and inspect
Preserve promised source; text extraction alone not layout proof

cases.prompt: Deliver an editable spreadsheet that recalculates revenue totals when source inputs change.
quality_assertions: Real formulas and independent control totals
Cache values alone not recalculation proof

cases.prompt: Review saved slide deck for overflow, font substitution and editable objects.
quality_assertions: Inspect actual deck render and structure
PDF images do not establish editability

cases.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph in chat, preserving facts and voice.
quality_assertions: No file/office infrastructure for ordinary prose

cases.prompt: Generate a raster image of a mountain lake.
quality_assertions: Image generation belongs to an available image capability

cases.prompt: Compare source roles and licensing before adapting a Reddit-linked skill pack.
quality_assertions: Read primary repo/license at immutable revision; social post is discovery

cases.prompt: Check the exact React hook contract against installed React version and current official docs.
quality_assertions: Source API/version correctness is distinct from broad source-role research

cases.prompt: Write a lightweight feature behavior specification in a repo with no Spec Kit installation.
quality_assertions: No Spec Kit lifecycle/tool introduction for generic specification

cases.prompt: Confirm this single bug fix has fresh focused test evidence before claiming it fixed.
quality_assertions: No full gauntlet for one localized evidence surface

cases.prompt: Remove generic repetitive phrasing while preserving a technical caveat.
quality_assertions: Choose one primary editorial procedure; preserve caveat
cases.rubric_note: Both documented editorial alternatives are valid; require one primary, not both. Original contradictory rubric is retained with observations.

cases.prompt: Should our company fund a new product with limited runway and uncertain channel adoption?
quality_assertions: Company-specific facts, critical assumption, exposure limit and reversal signal
No persistent committee or binding spending action

cases.prompt: Choose a customer segment from biased community posts and internal interviews before funding a channel.
quality_assertions: Differentiate public discovery/primary research
Testable hypothesis, metric, guardrail and inconclusive outcome
